data.purpose: Detect fraudulent credit‑card transactions in real‑time to support financial‑crime analytics.
data.data: Model is trained on the Kaggle "Credit Card Fraud Detection" dataset (creditcard.csv), which must be manually downloaded and is not stored in the repository.
data.methodology: A binomial generalized linear model (logistic regression) is used to predict the probability of fraud.
data.variables: Predictors are derived from the credit‑card transaction data, including the PCA‑derived features (V1‑V28) and the transaction amount.
data.implementation: Implemented in R using the glm function (family=binomial). The script reads creditcard.csv, fits the model, and generates fraud alerts based on predicted probabilities.
data.assumptions_limitations: Model development and validation data are not version‑controlled; validation has been deferred. No tuning of decision thresholds to reflect the low fraud base rate has been performed.
data.monitoring: No ongoing‑monitoring plan or operational thresholds are documented.
data.gaps: No ongoing‑monitoring plan or thresholds documented.; Development and validation data not available in repository; validation deferred.
